steps: Using fragmented knowledge, you wish the Scepter of Death into existence and win the bid. Mercurio leads Omnisky Aegis out of Philae. Meanwhile, a friend you thought you knew reveals who she really is.
18:15, Venatio Month 15th, Philae Monolith, The Boss's Domain
... I need this weapon to fire lead-core, brass-cased rounds.==W==
Rounds are packed with smokeless powder and a sensitive primer.
That's my wish. Please grant it.
I grab the dark Artifact. Cold metal and plastic... It feels familiar.
My ==SEX11==, its arm is severed! Your status?
The wish worked.==W== We're done here—let's move, Chitose!
Trekkers...==W== Why do you not fear—
My ==SEX11==, its arm is regenerating! Fast! It's about to strike!
Get to the elevator. I will cover you.
Chitose slides in, and I hammer the close button.
Chitose uses her Swordless Style, blocking the giant hand coming toward us.
Phew, that was close.==W== Good move, Chitose.
You flatter me.==W== As your blade, it's my duty.
Still...==W== Is this the Scepter of Death?
Yeah...==W== Looks like Amber's gun,==W== but this one uses gunpowder.==W== Pull the trigger, no magic required.
Powder... Like that in fireworks? It can do this?
Not exactly. It's a different kind. I don't remember the details,==W== but it's buried in my head.
Anyway, we won. Omnisky Aegis could never wish for an Artifact like this.
A weapon requiring no magic... Hmm—
My ==SEX11==, I am also a weapon that requires no magic—and I can talk to you!==W== You clearly don't need this Scepter of Death...!!
What? Where did that come from? It's going to the Grace Imperium. I won't be using it.
But you looked too happy when you were describing it.
Chitose is getting competitive. Time to change the subject...
Right, we got what we came for. Let's make our soul pact while we have the chance.
Ah, right. The soul pact. As you command.==W== Boss, here is my wish—
U-Um...==W== Apologies, my ==SEX11==. I realized I don't have a wish.==W== Or rather, all my wishes have come true.==W== I can't think of anything to ask of you...
How can that be? There must be something you want to do.
The wish to be with you again==W== is already fulfilled.
The wish to see the world through your eyes, as your blade...==W== That has come true, too.
I do want to protect you and never leave your side.==W== But that's my duty as your blade—something I have to earn myself. Wishing for it ...==W== doesn't feel right.
So... Can we complete the soul pact without a wish?
Can't do that. If I take your soul without giving anything back, it's no longer a trade.
The best I can do is owe you a wish for later, but even then, you still need an actual wish in mind.
A wish... A wish...==W== Ah...==W== Well, there is one thing I might wish for...
O-Okay...==W== Then...==W== Boss, here is my wish...
My ==SEX11==, would you... Would you forge a new blade with me?
And when that wish comes true... My soul is yours.
Yeah. I've got your back. Forging a blade sounds like fun. I'm looking forward to it.
Chitose reaches out==W== and holds on to the hem of my shirt.
Is everything ok?==W== You're blushing. Are you feeling alright?
It-It's nothing! I must be flustered by the intense battle just now...
Um... I look forward to the day we forge that blade together, my ==SEX11==...
Ah, we're here. Let's head back together, Chitose.
Stepping outside the Monolith, we hand the Artifact to Mistique, who is waiting outside, yawning.
We manage to deliver it right before sunset.
The next day, Grace Imperium announces the final bidding results—
For the Philae Monolith leasing project spanning 996 to 1005, the winning bidder is:==W== United Harvest Philae.

The official award notice will be sent to your company shortly. You have 30 days upon receipt to assume control of the Philae Monolith per the contract.==W== Dated: Monolith Calendar Year 996, Venatio Month 16th.
We pulled off an impossible comeback at the end. A miracle.
Oh, come on. We couldn't have done it without everyone pitching in!==W== Right, Chitose?
Mm...==W== Yeah...==W== This means I have time to forge a blade with my ==SEX11==.
Phew... Now that I can relax, I'm exhausted.==W== We'll leave the rest to you, Firenze.
We thank the Grace Imperium, Lady Albedo.
No need.==W== We chose the company that prioritizes the freedom and happiness of the people of Philae.
Well, I have other business to attend to, so I'll take my leave.
Photos,==W== photos,==W== more photos!==W== Look here, Boss! You're tomorrow's front page.==W== Smile! ★
Hey, camera off me. Aim it at Firenze.
At least Philae is finally at peace.
We lost, and burned 10 billion crashing the crystal diamond market...==W== Will we be fired?
The Senate will definitely axe me.==W== As for you? Hard to say.
Then again... If we'd blocked that 80 million, we would've won...==W== What is the Sky Institute Director playing at?
A call from Geminia?==W== They definitely want my head.
I'm sorry, Madam CEO. I promised a win and failed.==W== I officially resign from all positions.
Nonsense. You're staying, with full authority.==W==
The Senate threw a fit, but I handled it.==W== The bid, the market crash... They were all my calls.==W== I've already submitted my resignation.
Heehee, it takes me resigning for you to call me "sis" at work huh? Relax, they rejected it,==W== so no one takes the blame. ♪
They did? But ... how?==W== No one needs to take the fall?
A big shot came straight to me for a lifetime policy.==W== Once the Senate saw who it was, they were too terrified to even squeak.==W== Hilarious.
... I see.==W== Even so, Omnisky Aegis should just pull out of Philae.
Worried about Firenze and the Boss retaliating? Relax. The big shot promised to smooth things over.
No, it's not Firenze.==W== I think I made a fatal mistake.
I thought riding the coattails would buy us more power at Omnisky Aegis...==W== But I was wrong.==W== We—and this entire company—are nothing but pawns in this little game.
Omnisky Aegis quietly pulls out of Philae the very same night United Harvest Philae wins the bid.
Right now, Noya and the crew are prepping the Lucky Oasis. They plan to set sail tomorrow to track down leads on the orphanage.
Phew... Time to leave Philae. It's only been a few months, but honestly, it feels like a lifetime.
Such beautiful petals. They remind me of home.
Your home...==W== It must be an incredibly peaceful place. I'd love to see it for myself someday.
Wait for me here, Chitose. I have a private meeting with Serena.==W== Once I wrap this up, we can hit the road.
So this is Serena's room...==W== Right. I should probably ask her about the Armless Saint while I'm at it.==W== And those weird texts about the Tyrant I found in the Monolith.
I've been waiting. Please, come in.
Excuse me—==W==huh?==W== Oh, sorry, I think I have the wrong room.
You don't.==W== I'm just not wearing my cloak today.==W== Don't you recognize me, Boss?
The cloak...==W== Wait, so you really are Serena?==W== Since I'd never actually seen your face, I was dead sure I had the wrong person.
Guilty as charged.==W== Since it's just the two of us, hiding under a hood felt rather rude.==W== I figured it was time we met face-to-face.
Still...==W== It's crazy how just ditching a cloak completely changes a person's entire aura.
Anyway... You mentioned there was something you wanted to discuss?
Truth be told, selling information is just a side gig. My real passion is the history of the Tyrant.
You unfroze the legendary Boss Accord. You possess multiple Seals of Grace, including one that's never even been documented.
So, I was hoping we could talk. I figured you might be able to shed some light on my Tyrant research.
Makes sense. You've done a lot for us, so it's only right that I tell you what I know. No secrets.
Unfortunately...==W== By the time the New Star Guild pulled me out of the Monolith, I'd already lost my memories.
I can't mention Vita, the White Room, or the king piece's power... But the rest should be fine.
I know about your amnesia. That's why I'd rather ask about a few things that seem ... off.

For instance,==W== you waged a company war for the New Star Guild and the Ashwind Clan.==W== Actually, once you have the Seal of Grace, you should be able to get Creta Trading to treat your companions with proper respect just by going through a few well-connected intermediaries.==W== That would've been the smarter play.
Back then, I barely knew which way was up. I wasn't thinking that far ahead.
But even if I had, I still would've chosen the company war.
Sure, those of us with a Seal of Grace could negotiate peace. But what about the kids on the street who don't have one?
Haha, you are a gentle soul.==W== I imagine you would've stepped in to help Fuyuka even if I hadn't offered information in exchange.
Probably.==W== Just like the New Star Guild saved me at my lowest. We're all Trekkers. Helping each other out is what we do.
A spirit of mutual aid...==W== What about later, then? When Darcia hailed you as the Tyrant, why did you turn her down?
H-How do you know about that?
Heh, I'm an information broker. I have my sources.==W== With her unwavering loyalty, you could've used her power to get things done a lot faster.
It was a strong power, sure.==W== But if you rely on brute force to make people do what you want...==W== Even with good intentions, it always ends badly.
It's like trekking.==W== If I only want to follow the paved path, I'll only ever take the same route as every other==W== and never see anything new.
If I want real change, then I can't just pick the path that "looks easy."
Your mindset surprises me.==W== It's nothing like that of a CEO.
Someone told me the same thing recently.==W== So, how does a proper CEO think?
It varies. But at the end of the day, most people who climb that high aren't saints.
And someone like you, willing to sacrifice yourself for others? That's rare...==W== You could say it's practically nonexistent.
I think you're exaggerating...==W== But either way, someone like me clearly has nothing to do with the legendary evil Tyrant.
True.==W== Even if you were the real Tyrant... I'm sure you'd be a kind one.
Then, let's try a different angle...==W== During your time in Philae, what has been your impression of the place?
Phew. That's all I can tell you.
Thank you for your time. This information is invaluable—it's a massive step forward for my Tyrant research.
Wait here a moment. I have a gift for you, to thank you for today.
You don't have to do that.==W== Oh, and Serena? Since you've been studying the Tyrant, have you heard of this before?
The Devil Emperor wakes within the pupil...
Dividing the power of death among all living things.
The legendary Tyrant is immortal. Kill ==SEX4== with ordinary weapons, and ==SEX== resurrects time and again.==W== And with every rebirth, ==SEX== returns stronger.
The Tyrant overturns the rules of society, empowers ordinary people to slaughter powerful mages, and destroys the world.
The Emperor withdraws their grace. Sweet dew becomes bitter wormwood.
The earth shatters. The anointed wicked rise from the bottomless pit.
This place shall be stripped of its name. Left barren and lifeless for eternity.
So...==W== This prophecy foretells==W== the end of the world?
Yes.==W== Every century, the Tyrant is reborn in Nova. And the only way to stop the world from ending ...==W== is to kill ==SEX4==.
Right... Kill the Tyrant.==W== Haha...==W== A legendary figure like that couldn't actually exist, right?
Hehe. I forgot to mention... The Tyrant in the Book of Grace Prophecies is someone who does the good deeds no one else will.
Oh. So they're a good person.==W== But why are you telling me this? It sounds like you're implying that … I'm...
I've watched you for a long time. Every action, every word—they perfectly align with the prophecy.
And who else but the Tyrant could wish for a weapon that doesn't even belong in this world?
W-Wait a minute! What are you talking about?! This is all your speculation!
Speculation... Yes. But the prophecy is never wrong, and you are a ninety-nine percent match.
But what if I'm not the Tyrant?!==W== You'd be killing the wrong person!
You're right.==W== But if sacrificing your one life could save the world...==W== I am willing to take that gamble.
If my judgment is wrong, I will find a way to atone.
What good is atonement after I'm dead?!==W== This is insane...!
You are a good person, and I hold no personal grudge against you.==W== So, I am deeply sorry, but for the sake of this world... I must ask you to die. You have my gratitude.
Please, accept this bullet—one that grants equal death to all.
I hope this time, you find eternal rest.==W== Farewell...==W== Tyrant.
